tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground. Dark is the primary look; light follows the visitor's OS setting or the toggle.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Text, wordmark and hairline rules at full strength, on canvas or surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, mono labels and annotations on canvas and surface. Meets AA on both. Never on an inverse band or an accent field.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline separators and quiet outlines. Default rule between sections, ledger rows and cards.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels one step off the canvas.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for outline chips, cards and rows.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: The one solid button per composition, and inverted bands.

tokens.name: inverse-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on the solid button.

tokens.name: inverse-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on inverse. Supporting copy on an inverse band uses this at 75% opacity.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px outline, 2px offset (4px around particle canvases).

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection background, inverted.

tokens.name: selection-foreground
tokens.usage: Text selection foreground.

tokens.name: tavren
tokens.usage: Tavren's accent, from its game UI (--gold). A fill only: the field, the hex highlight, a progress rule in its section. Never text on canvas in light (1.4:1); text on it uses on-tavren.

tokens.name: on-tavren
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a tavren field: Tavren's own ink (--ink). 10.4:1 on gold.

tokens.name: kora
tokens.usage: Kora's accent, its primary brand violet in both themes. Fill for its section wash and route marks; also usable as large text (24px+) on canvas.

tokens.name: on-kora
tokens.usage: Text on a kora field: white on #5B4BE0 (6.0:1), near-black on #8B7CFF (6.1:1).

tokens.name: cotrip
tokens.usage: Cotrip's accent: its coral (--coral), chosen over its brand violet so it never reads as Kora. Fill for its section, the drawn route line, map pins.

tokens.name: on-cotrip
tokens.usage: Text on a cotrip field. 6.2:1 on coral.

tokens.name: tower
tokens.usage: Campaign Tower's accent, from its pixel palette (--green). Fill for its section, the lift, the pixel floors.

tokens.name: on-tower
tokens.usage: Text on a tower field. 8.3:1 on green.

styles.name: poster
styles.usage: Structural graphic type. Fluid in the build: clamp(3.25rem, 18cqi, 15rem). May be cropped by its column. Never for text that must be read in full.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: Project names and section statements. Fluid in the build: clamp(2.75rem, 7cqi, 4.5rem). Measure 18ch.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro copy and the hero subhead (the one reading text that speaks in).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy. Measure 68ch, or 42ch narrow. Never animated.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Labels: section numbers, project metadata, nav. Uppercase.

styles.name: annotation
styles.usage: Margin notes, stacks, years. The floor: never smaller, never cropped. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Micro shift distance; icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps between label and value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Component padding; page-level shift distance.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side padding on mobile; grid gutter.

tokens.name: gutter-lg
tokens.usage: Page side padding from 640px up.

tokens.name: section
tokens.usage: Space between sections on the static page; pinned scenes use 100vh instead.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Hairline-adjacent marks, the progress rule cap.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Small chips; display-size buttons.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Chips, project cards and screenshot frames. The largest radius: the system stays editorial.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Default separator. Rules, ledger rows, card outlines on surface.

tokens.name: strong
tokens.usage: Chips, buttons, focus ring, and a card that must stand off the canvas.
